title: Gaussian bivariate density
statement: For real parameters $\rho,a,b$, define the Gaussian bivariate density by $I(a)\,\phi\!\left(\frac{\Phi^{-1}(b)-\rho\Phi^{-1}(a)}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}\right)/\sqrt{1-\rho^2}$, where $I$ is the Gaussian isoperimetric function, $\phi$ is the standard Gaussian density, and $\Phi^{-1}$ is the standard Gaussian quantile function.
